statement: The solved region (reason/solved.mjs, in act/prompt.mjs right after direct) was filled from the journals under bench/verdicts: 226 templates from 620 journal rows that carry a program, covering 188 GSM8K records (226 compiled, 0 sandbox). On 200 held-out GSM8K test records no development journal names (sampleIds at seed public/1), asked through ask() with the model cell offline, solved answered 0 (0.0%); so it has no accuracy to set beside the published Llama 3.1 405B Instruct 96.8; 199 were answered by no sub-token class and fell through to the next region, 199 of them to the same answer the ask path gives with solved off. The solved step took a median 1310 ns and a p99 9927 ns per response on those records (1000 repeats each, a miss: what solved adds to an ask it does not answer), a whole ask() (the next region answering, 100 repeats) a median 1593093 ns; an empty clock bracket reads a median 41 ns. The slot forms of the 1319 GSM8K test records repeat 0 times, and 0 held-out records share a template's form: an exact slot-form memory filled from other records cannot answer held-out GSM8K, and the gap "ns class share" is opened with the loop's own fill as its trial. The memoisation control, the 188 development records a template was filled from, was answered by solved 188 times, 188 right, at a median 1514 ns and a p99 8487 ns a response (a whole ask() median 4294 ns); the same questions with their numbers doubled were answered 171 of 183 times, the sandbox agreeing 171 of 171. THE WORD CLASS (act/word.mjs, method exact.word, provenance exact, no model): on the same 200 held-out records it answered 1 (0.5%), 1 right; every sub-token class together answered 1 (0.5%) with 1 right, against the bar of 100%. The word step (readWord alone, 1000 repeats a record, two passes) took a median 47079 ns and a p99 173271 ns on every held-out record, a median 82196 ns on the ones it answered. The control graded the same held-out records with the word reader unplugged: 0 and 0 sub-token answers in two passes (exact.word 0 and 0); plugged: 1 and 1; the gain 0.5% against a run-to-run noise of 0.0%. 1 model-off grading journal (bench/verdicts/public/gsm8k-native-public_1.jsonl, 33 ids) was left out of development: it holds the sub-token answers themselves, and counting its ids would move the records the word reader answers out of held out. The word rules were written reading only the 203 development records bench/public.mjs gsm8kDevIds names (tools/word-dev.mjs extracted them); no held-out record was read while the rules were written. The wiki direct class was not measured: the knowledge store (bench/fixtures/wiki/store) is absent on this host. The wiki direct class was not re-measured in this run.
